quibble.definition:
n. an evasion of the point of an argument by raising irrelevant distinctions or objections
v. evade the truth of a point or question by raising irrelevant objections
v. argue over petty things
quibble.translation:
n. 遁词, 双关语
vi. 吹毛求疵, 争吵, 说模棱两可的话
vt. 对...诡辩

quibbled.translation: v. 使用遁词, 含糊其辞, 吹毛求疵( quibble的过去式和过去分词 )

quibbler.definition: n. a disputant who quibbles; someone who raises annoying petty objections
quibbler.translation:
n. 诡辩者
[法] 诡辩者, 狡辩者

quibbles.definition:
n an evasion of the point of an argument by raising irrelevant distinctions or objections
v evade the truth of a point or question by raising irrelevant objections
v argue over petty things
quibbles.translation:
n. 吹毛求疵的反对意见或批评, 遁词, 模棱两可的话( quibble的名词复数 )
v. 使用遁词, 含糊其辞, 吹毛求疵( quibble的第三人称单数 )

quibbling.definition:
v evade the truth of a point or question by raising irrelevant objections
v argue over petty things
quibbling.translation:
n. 诡辩, 吹毛求疵, 找碴子
a. 吹毛求疵的, 挑剔的

quibblingly.translation: adv. 吹毛求疵地, 推诿地

quibron.translation: [医]茶-愈胶囊（含茶碱和愈创甘油醚）<支气管扩张药，祛痰药>
